_what: Assignment pack for the process specification campaign. Everything you need about YOUR category. The full model.json is 148 KB and you do not need it; if you want a process id outside this category, ask.
_binding: _Collab/00_prompts/SPEC_CAMPAIGN_PROMPT.md is the binding instruction. _Collab/SOURCE_AUTHORITY_PACK.md is the only permitted source list. Read both in full before writing anything.

bands.Work Lifecycle: 1.0-5.0. Runs in sequence for a single piece of work.
bands.Specialised Operations: 6.0-11.0. Each runs the full lifecycle inside its own operational discipline.
bands.Foundations and Enabling: 12.0-16.0. Supplies assets, materials, workforce, information and external delivery capacity to every lifecycle stage rather than sitting inside the sequence.
bands.Asset Lifecycle: 17.0-19.0. The asset's own life - planned, created, operated and retired - as distinct from the work performed on it. Appended 2026-08-29 without renumbering anything: categories 1.0 to 16.0 keep their ids, uids and legacy_ids.

lifecycle_axis._why: The model is organised on a WORK axis - identify, plan, schedule, execute, close. APQC and GFMAM are organised on an ASSET axis - plan and acquire, design and construct, operate, maintain, dispose. The work axis is what happens inside 'maintain'. Both are valid; carrying both lets the model answer ISO 55001:2024 cl. 8.1 without abandoning the granularity that makes it a process model rather than a benchmarking taxonomy.
lifecycle_axis._all: 'all' marks an enabling category that serves every stage rather than sitting at one of them.

your_category.name: Manage Assets and Asset Information

processes.name: Define system of record by asset class
Reconcile spatial and non-spatial asset records
Publish asset changes to the spatial network model
Consume spatial network and connectivity updates
Resolve orphaned, duplicate and mismatched records
Operate distributed asset data across territories
Define linear assets and their measure basis
Apply linear referencing and measure points
Maintain dynamic segmentation along the asset
Record condition, defect and work by segment
Split, merge and re-measure linear segments
Validate failure mode, mechanism, cause and consequence
Maintain asset health and criticality scoring
Maintain job plans and task libraries

groups.name: Manage asset risk and compliance obligations

processes.name: Assess asset risk and consequence of failure

your_category.summary: Establish and maintain the asset record, understand asset condition and risk, and set the maintenance strategy that generates work.

apqc_rows_touching_your_category.note: Plan asset maintenance. The model splits this one APQC process across six groups, which is the right granularity for a work management reference.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Technical Standards & Legislation
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Regulatory obligation register plus the compliance category.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Management of Change
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Change to authorised work scope (2.4.4) and asset-related technical change (12.6.4). No organisational or management-system change process, which is correct here.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Risk
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Asset risk and consequence of failure, and the distribution integrity programme.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Planning
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Closed 2026-08-29. 17.2 determines the solution, 17.4 builds and monitors the capital programme. 12.5 continues to define maintenance strategy and 12.6.3 replacement and renewal.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Decision-Making
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Prioritisation, approval routing and asset risk. The model expresses these as DMN decision tables, which is exactly the auditability GFMAM asks for.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Knowledge Management
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Job plan and task libraries, and the document set at the place of work.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Asset Management Data & Information Strategy
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: System of record by asset class, and data quality and master data.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Configuration Management
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Asset specifications and as-built update. No configuration baseline or version control over the asset configuration itself.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Integrated Reliability
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Performance and reliability analysis, and failure mode validation. No reliability engineering feedback loop into design.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Asset Repurposing or Disposal
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Closed 2026-08-29. 19.2 decommissions physically, 19.3 handles waste and salvage, 19.4 transfers ownership and closes the record. 12.1.6 continues to retire the record and 5.3 the accounting.
